mapper.select: /* TITLENAME:标题名(普通产品取产品名称 ,分级产品取 母产品名称+（子产品代码）) PPRODID：普通产品：数据本身的prodid,分级产品：母产品的prodid */ select case when rpi.IS_GRADE = '01' then rpi2.prod_name ||'（'||rpi.prod_id||'）' else rpi.prod_name end TITLENAME, nvl(rpi2.prod_id,rpi.prod_id) PPRODID from rep_prod_info rpi /*查询普通产品或者母产品数据 p_prod_id:母产品代码：当为子产品时填写母产品代码。普通产品为自己的产品代码。母产品为空*/ left join rep_prod_info rpi2 on rpi.p_prod_id = rpi2.prod_id and rpi2.status = 'E' where rpi.prod_id = #{prodId} and rpi.status = 'E'

SELECT to_char(open_start_date,'yyyy/MM/dd') OPENVDATE, to_char(open_end_date,'yyyy/MM/dd') OPENEDATE, to_char(collingoff_period,'yyyy/MM/dd') COLLINCOFFPERIOD, to_char(auto_redeem_date,'yyyy/MM/dd') CONFIRMDATE FROM dis_prod_plan where PROD_ID = #{prodId,jdbcType=VARCHAR} AND OPEN_START_DATE <= to_date(#{endDate},'yyyy-MM-dd') AND OPEN_START_DATE >= to_date(#{startDate},'yyyy-MM-dd')
